row.name: shorey
row.description: Shorey is a simple note app which is built with Flutter 2 3 and supports both Android/iOS platforms. It provides me full experience of interacting with Flutter and in the meantime I hope it can be your knowledge/memory transition tool, and yes, there are still much work to do.
